attacks.name: White Drop
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon V, this attack does 50 more damage.

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Frozen Awakening
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Crystal Veil
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon VMAX, except any Glaceon VMAX.

attacks.name: Max Icicle
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules.label: VMAX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

text.name: Cryogonal

attacks.name: Element Chain
attacks.text: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach any number of basic Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

text.flavor: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at –148 degrees Fahrenheit.

text.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Pika Strike
attacks.text: If 1 of your Dedenne used Dede-Short during your last turn, this attack does 180 more damage.

text.flavor: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

text.name: Glastrier

attacks.name: Freeze Down
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

text.name: Snom

attacks.name: Find Ice
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 {Water} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

text.name: Stantler

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.flavor: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.
